text:
mira (People Ops): quick alert 1: several interviewers reported they could open submitted scorecards from other interviewers for the same candidate. Example: INT-101 opened INT-203's feedback for CAN-1203 and saw private notes.
viv (Recruiting Ops): we had a candidate ask why multiple interviewers' comments were visible. This looks like a permissions issue, not training.
noel (Eng - Backend): any clue when this started?
viv (Recruiting Ops): first report came in this morning ~09:10. I traced it to panels created yesterday evening.
permissions-audit-bot: scan started audit-run-772 at 2026-07-12T09:35:00Z
permissions-audit-bot: preliminary: 11 panels with "scorecard_view" ACL set to "panel" instead of "individual" (likely intended to restrict per-interviewer views).
noel (Eng - Backend): that ACL change rings a bell. We shipped a small change last week to add a convenience "panel share" option for external vendors; defaulting codepath mistakenly flipped the default for some import routes. I'll roll back the default immediately.
tess (Interview Training): immediate impact: interviewers may feel unsafe writing candid feedback. We should notify affected interviewers and hiring owners and ask them to avoid updating feedback until fixed.
noel (Eng - Backend): mitigation plan: 1) revoke public/panel-level access on affected panels (script revoke-acs-882) 2) roll back the default for new panels 3) run a migration to convert "panel" ACLs to "individual" where appropriate and log changes. I'll run the revoke script now.
scorecard-service-bot: revoke-acs-882 executed: 11 panels updated, ACL set to "individual", audit id=acl-999
noel (Eng - Backend): rollback patch deployed (revert-448) at 2026-07-12T09:52Z. Also adding an ingest validation to prevent vendor/import routes from setting panel-level ACL unless explicitly allowed.
permissions-audit-bot: full scan completed: 11 affected panels, no evidence of external link generation, no reads from unknown accounts detected. Audit report: report-2034567890 attached to internal drive.
viv (Recruiting Ops): thanks. I'll message affected interviewers/hiring owners with an apology and note that we revoked access and are re-running permissions checks.
tess (Interview Training): can we add a short line to the interviewer training about "where to expect private vs panel-level feedback" so folks know what to expect?
mira (People Ops): yes, please add that. Also let's add a runbook step: any ACL/default change must go through a quick prod-check with a smoke audit.
cal-bot: command acknowledged: adding calendar note to affected panels: "Scorecard permissions updated by People Ops. If you see missing feedback, contact hiring ops."
viv (Recruiting Ops): closing loop for now. Please reopen if any further visibility reports come in. :white_check_mark:
